description: Get SMS messages for a specific phone number, identified by its number ID. Returns a list of individual messages — each with its timestamp, sender, recipient, and text — rather than grouped conversation threads. Results are newest first. To page through older history, pass the nextCursor from one response as cursor on the next; before/after are optional time filters only.

after.description: Optional time filter: only messages after this ISO 8601 timestamp. Ignored when cursor is set.

before.description: Optional time filter: only messages before this ISO 8601 timestamp. Ignored when cursor is set.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from a previous page; the reliable way to fetch the next page. Takes precedence over before/after.

limit.description: How many messages to return in one page.

number_id.description: The ID of the number whose messages you want, from list_numbers.

name: get_messages

outputSchema.description: A page of messages for a specific phone number.

data.description: Messages for the number, newest first.

from.description: Sender number (get_messages shape), or null if unknown.

hasMore.description: Whether more results exist beyond this page.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; pass it back as cursor. null/absent when there is no next page.

total.description: Total matching records across all pages.

title: Get Messages
